$comment: The ONE secret-shaped ruleset for this repository. EPIC-08's Reuse note says two divergent secret regexes would be a real hazard, and names EPIC-03's gitleaks ruleset as the source. EPIC-03 does not exist yet, so this file is the source instead -- EPIC-03 must GENERATE its .gitleaks.toml from this file or cite it, never fork it. Consumed today by scripts/redact.mjs and scripts/check-ledger.mjs. Patterns carry an explicit `flags` field because JavaScript has no inline (?i)/(?m) syntax; consumers compile regex+flags.
owner: EPIC-08 until EPIC-03 lands; then EPIC-03

patterns.description: key/token/secret assigned a long opaque value
32 hex characters standing alone -- the shape of the weather API keys Mist uses (K1/K2, docs/KEY_ROTATION.md)
a PEM private key, header through footer -- redacting only the header would leave the key body in the transcript
three base64url segments separated by dots

personalDataPatterns.description: absolute path through a user's home directory -- leaks a username
any email address NOT at example.invalid (deploy/real-mail-domains.txt is the fixture-data rule; transcripts are stricter -- only example.invalid survives)
a shell environment dump line; the variable name is kept, the value removed
